title: Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.26060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity score

translated_title: 迭代稀缺性引导探索：从狭窄数据支撑中自举生成式自动竞价
translated_abstract: 自动竞价是在线广告拍卖中的核心算法组件。在实际的冷启动场景中，迭代训练通常被用来补偿低质量、支撑范围狭窄的历史数据。遗憾的是，在迭代训练过程中，代表性的基于扩散模型的AI生成竞价（AIGB）方法无法在狭窄的数据支撑之外持续进行外推探索，从而停滞在次优水平。本文从理论上将这种停滞归因于信噪比（SNR）崩溃：微弱的径向回报信号被曲率引起的惩罚所淹没。为了打破这种停滞，我们提出了迭代稀缺性引导探索（ISGE），它引入了一种引导交接机制：当回报信号崩溃时，稀缺性随之接管作为探索性信号，将信噪比提升至临界阈值以上。具体而言，ISGE在一个为数据分配稀缺性得分的评判器之间迭代交替……
tldr: 该论文从理论上揭示了生成式自动竞价在狭窄数据支撑下停滞的根因是信噪比崩溃，并提出迭代稀缺性引导探索（ISGE）方法，通过在回报信号崩溃时让稀缺性接管作为探索信号以提升信噪比，从而突破次优停滞实现自举式改进。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically attributes the stagnation of generative auto-bidding under narrow data support to SNR collapse and proposes Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE), which introduces a guidance handoff where scarcity takes over as an exploratory signal when the return signal collapses, elevating SNR above a critical threshold to bootstrap beyond suboptimal performance.
